'''W-Engines''' are spherical weapons in ''[[Zenless Zone Zero]]'' that [[Agent]]s can equip to empower their attacks and increase their [[Stats]] in combat.

==Overview==
'''W-Engines''' are separated into seven categories, based on the ''Agent'' [[Specialty|Specialties]]:
* {{Specialty|Attack|24|link=1|nobr=1}}
* {{Specialty|Anomaly|24|link=1|nobr=1}}
* {{Specialty|Stun|24|link=1|nobr=1}}
* {{Specialty|Support|24|link=1|nobr=1}}
* {{Specialty|Defense|24|link=1|nobr=1}}
* {{Specialty|Rupture|24|link=1|nobr=1}}
* {{Specialty|Armorer|24|link=1|nobr=1}}
Any Agent can equip a given W-Engine, however only those whose specialty matches the engine can use its W-Engine Effect. Only one W-Engine can be equipped to an agent at a time, accessible from the [[Equipment Menu]].

Each W-Engine has both a ''Main Stat'' and ''Sub Stat'', with the Main Stat typically being [[Stats#ATK|Base ATK]], while the Sub Stat will typically be valuable to agents of the corresponding specialty. Furthermore, each W-Engine also comes with a '''W-Engine Effect''', which provides a passive bonus to the equipped Agent during gameplay.

'''Enhancing''' (read: leveling-up) a W-Engine increases its Main Stat, while the Sub Stat will only be increased after '''Modification''' (read: promoting/ascending). The ''W-Engine Effect'' can also be improved by '''Overclocking''' (read: refining/limit-breaking) the W-Engine to its next Phase, using duplicate copies obtained through [[Signal Search]]es.

W-Engines can come in 3 rarities, {{Rank|B;A;S}} with each higher rarity offering better stats and passives, but also requiring more resources to Modify.

==How to Obtain==
{{Main|Signal Search}}
W-Engines can be obtained by performing '''Signal Searches''', which can be accessed through the Main Menu or by pressing the F4 key (PC only).

{{Rank|B;A}} Rank W-Engines can also be crafted at [[Box Galaxy]] on [[Sixth Street]], requiring the usage of different amounts of {{Item|W-Engine Chip}}, depending on the rarity of the desired W-Engine.

==Enhancing==
{{Main|W-Engine EXP Material}}
The level of a W-Engine can be '''enhanced''' with [[W-Engine EXP Material]]s, increasing its Main Stat. The cost to do increases with the Rank of the W-Engine. While enhancing, any excess EXP granted by used materials is refunded as lower tier materials.

==Modification==
{{Main|W-Engine Modification Material}}
Every 10 levels, a W-Engine must be '''modified''' in order to continue enhancing it. Doing so also increases its Main and Sub Stats. Modifying a W-Engine costs a varying amount of both [[Dennies]] and its Specialty-specific '''Component''', depending on the rarity of the W-Engine.

==Exclusive W-Engines==
{{Main|Tutorial/Exclusive W-Engine Effects}}
Every Agent has their own Exclusive W-Engine with the same rank as them. After equipping an Exclusive W-Engine, the player can activate the W-Engine switch in the Agent's Equipment Menu. The switch can be freely toggled On/Off when out of combat. When turned on, the Agent will display unique visual effects in combat.

==Trivia==
===Etymology===
* The "W" in W-Engine may stand for "Weapon," as [[Anby]] literally states that they are weapons,<ref>{{Ref/Episode|Proxy Business}}</ref> although the most probable reading is "Wave", for soundwave; the latter would be in line with the Chinese meaning.
** Additionally, it is said that "soundwaves can protect against corruption."<ref>{{Ref/Dialogue|Piper Wheel|Trust|condition = Outside Turbo Remodeling Shop|quote= '''Enzo:''' What was it people say? The guy who first discovered soundwaves could protect against corruption just wanted to jam out while he was beating up an Ethereal...?}}</ref>
* The Chinese name for W-Engines, {{zh|音擎|rm = Yīnqíng}}, is a portmanteau for {{zh|音|rm = yīn|tl = sound}} and {{zh|引擎|rm = yǐnqíng|tl = engine}}.
